description: Creates a new action item on a retrospective board. Requires mcp:write scope.

assign_to.description: User ID to assign the action item to — call retro.team.members.list to get it — or "me" to assign to the current user.

board_id.description: The ID of the board to create the action item on.

priority.description: Priority: high, medium, or low. Default: medium.

text.description: The text of the action item.

name: retro.actions.create
title: Create Action Item Tool
